comment: Evidence RDY-010 requires that no producer in this repository can currently generate. Each gap is acknowledged, tracked, and release-blocking. The validator downgrades exactly these types to warnings so blocking CI can enforce everything else; it fails if an undeclared gap appears, and it also fails once a declared gap's evidence becomes available, so this ledger can only shrink. RDY-010 stays open until it is empty.

gaps.reason: The Windows host now emits one direct SPARK_MODULE_LIFECYCLE record after normal teardown, and tools/module-evidence/collect_lifecycle.py authenticates the exact Windows engine/DLL package before producing fixed lifecycle evidence. No required same-workflow CI producer yet runs that collector from the immutable Windows Release artifact at the exact SHA; this remaining producer gap keeps RDY-010 open. Profile-scoped package smoke remains independently tracked under MOD-310.

Tests/PackageSmoke registers SparkInstalledPackageSmoke, but it runs only in .github/workflows/release.yml and is not scoped to a module profile, so it produces no per-module package evidence in blocking CI. MOD-310 owns closing this.
